To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the following tools and drivers are relevant to design actions with resilient communities: 1) design tools that support community members in the design and implementation of their own solutions; 2) design tools that are co-designed with community members and are based on their knowledge; 3) design tools that help community members to understand the context and to develop their own solutions; and 4) design tools that enable community members to develop their own capacity for innovation and problem-solving.

the following are the most important drivers of resilience: 1. The capacity of communities to manage environmental, social and economic urgencies. 2. The capacity of institutions to manage environmental and economic urgencies in a sustainable manner. 3. The capacity of individuals to adapt and innovate in the face of environmental and social urgencies.
the design tools are a key driver for the resilience of local communities, and the resilience of local community can be achieved by design actions.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: 1. How to identify the right design actions to support the resilience of a local community? 2. How to engage local communities in a process of resilience? 3. How to develop the right conditions to support resilient processes?
design actions with resilient communities

• the role of design as a tool for the development of resilience strategies; • the role of local communities as actors in resilience strategies; • a method to identify and analyse drivers for resilience; • the role played by local communities as actors of resilience; • the use of tools to support resilience actions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
design actions can contribute to the development of resilient local communities through goals, drivers, and tools.
design research and actions can create the right conditions for engaging resilient processes in the local communities.

the research projects presented in this paper are a good starting point for a further and deeper reflection on design actions with resilient processes and communities, and the role of design in the process of building resilience.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the design research and actions are the right conditions for resilient processes.
we have been able to show the potentialities of a design approach in the development of a local community.
design research and actions are able to engage resilient processes, through the development of goals, drivers and specific design tools.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design process can be a tool to engage resilient processes in local communities.
the design actions with resilient communities are based on goals, drivers and methods that are able to support the design of resilient local communities.
design research and actions with resilient local community is possible through a series of tools that can support the engagement of the community.
